violations.text: Menus lack allergen statement. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

Milk was observed held at 44 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC turned down mini fridge. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

Thermometers are lacking in refrigeration units. Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026
The walk-in cooler in the kitchen area is in poor repair (drip observed from compressor/piping). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2026
Establishment does not have a grease receptible for disposals. New Violation. Correct By: 10/20/2026
The ceiling in the beverage prep areas are covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2026

The ceiling tiles above the dry storage and dining/game areas are in poor repair (previous water damage). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the kitchen area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2026
